stages.name: CRO + mobile + accessibility hardening
stages.detail: Explicit size selection, sticky mobile CTA, checkout handoff, unavailable sizes, focus handling and native filters.

stages.name: Production hardening
stages.detail: Safe fallbacks, structured data, metadata, pagination and internal preflight.

stages.name: Analytics instrumentation
stages.detail: Shopify Customer Events ownership + 8 misca:* custom events. Real pixel QA still pending.

stages.name: GitHub source + official Theme Check
stages.detail: Dedicated repository, main canonical, official Theme Check green on PR and main.

stages.name: Visual storefront preview on GitHub Pages
stages.detail: V10 connects commerce preview, product-direction A/B and provisional workshop sheets to Product Ready.

stages.name: Safe Shopify preview pipeline
stages.detail: Unpublished pre/post role checks, strict push, evidence summary and no live-publish path.

stages.name: One-time MISCA Preview bootstrap
stages.detail: Creates the first unpublished theme without needing a theme ID; returns ID and preview/editor URLs.

stages.name: 2026 blank + print supplier refresh
stages.detail: Current public evidence reviewed; historical T230/T265/X300 no longer authorize sample priority.

stages.name: Supplier reconfirmation
stages.detail: Issue #18: confirm composition, gramaje, M, colors, sample price, stock/replenishment and print-test terms before purchase.

stages.name: First physical blank samples
stages.detail: Authorize only after written quote/spec confirmation. Then weigh, measure, fit-test and wash.

stages.name: Raíz + Ola print tests
stages.detail: Raíz RC-SCR-01 vs RC-DTF-01; Ola OLA-DTG-01 vs OLA-DTF-01 after blank selection.

stages.name: Shopify runtime configuration
stages.detail: Parallel blocker: configure SHOPIFY_CLI_THEME_TOKEN and SHOPIFY_FLAG_STORE in GitHub Actions.

stages.name: First persistent Shopify preview
stages.detail: Run Bootstrap Shopify preview theme after runtime configuration.

stages.name: Storefront QA
stages.detail: 40 checks across Home, PLP, PDP, cart, search, mobile, accessibility and runtime behavior.

stages.name: Analytics QA
stages.detail: 12 checks covering standard Customer Events and misca:* custom events.

stages.name: Product Ready — Raíz + Ola
stages.detail: Supplier sourcing active. Blank, fit, print, wash, factual specs, real COGS, photography and sellable inventory still require physical evidence.

stages.name: Controlled launch
stages.detail: Requires Product Ready + real preview QA + E2E commerce + analytics QA.

nextGate.name: PHYSICAL SAMPLE SOURCING
actions: Contact Wholesale VAB: confirm 250gr/320gr composition, M, Marfil/Ivory, Navy, sample price and stock.
Contact West Basic: confirm Peruana Premium 310gr and Elite Doblepunto composition, M, colors and sample price.
Contact Paquete Completo: quote one physical 250gr/300gr sample without committing to production MOQ.
Quote RC-SCR-01 vs RC-DTF-01 with a Medellin printer accepting MISCA-supplied blanks.
Quote OLA-DTG-01 vs OLA-DTF-01; prioritize a real DTG specialist for the DTG side.
Authorize samples only after written spec + price + availability evidence.
Keep Shopify Config running as a parallel external blocker; do not wait on it to progress Product Ready.
